shortDescription: According to CNBC, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the company will not go public this year, citing growing concerns about AI safety. In an interview with Fortune published Saturday, Altman said an IPO now would be "ill-advised."

title: OpenAI Rules Out IPO This Year as Altman Cites AI Safety Concerns
